NEET PG 2026 Results Declared, Cut-offs Released

The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduate (NEET PG) 2026 results have been declared. Alongside the results, the merit list and category-wise cutoff scores have also been released. For the general category, the cutoff score is 262 marks.
